defs.def: to be the first person to become aware that a particular place or thing exists （第一个）发现

ex.s: To discover mineral resources.
ex.t: 发现矿产资源。

ex.s: I began a second drawer for more general discoveries: new cave system discovered with dozens of nameless species, four hundred species of bacteria found in the human stomach.
ex.t: 我开始了第二个抽屉，用来放更一般的发现：被发现的有几十种无名物种的新洞穴系统、在人体胃部发现的四百种细菌。

ex.s: And I’ve discovered some great books!
ex.t: 而且我发现了一些很棒的书！

ex.s: Then, one after another, Sydney discovered lots of things that were just sort of there — broad parks, superb beaches, and a culturally diverse population.
ex.t: 然后，悉尼一个接一个地发现了许多原本就在那里的东西——宽阔的公园、绝美的海滩和多元文化的人口。

ex.s: Robbie Pruitt admitted that he got 16   when he discovered the theft of his mountain bike last September.
ex.t: 罗比·普鲁特承认去年9月发现他的山地自行车被偷时他很   16   愤怒。

ex.s: Mari starts changing her life and discovers a world of diverse ”night people” who are hiding secrets.
ex.t: 玛丽开始改变自己的生活，发现了一个由隐藏着秘密、形形色色的“夜行人”组成的世界。

ex.s: Then I discovered an app called Running Power.
ex.t: 然后我发现了一个名为Running Power的应用程序。

ex.s: I’ve discovered that if I show students how what they learn is relevant to my hobbies, they’re much more willing to make connections to their personal interests and develop their own hobbies.
ex.t: 我发现，如果我向学生展示所学内容与我的爱好的关联，他们就更愿意把知识与自己的兴趣联系起来，并培养出自己的爱好。

ex.s: He discovered that whether someone describes having had some control over events in their past is an important predictor of a person’s mental health.
ex.t: 他发现，一个人是否描述自己过去对事件有过某种掌控感，是预测其心理健康的重要指标。

ex.s: to discoverB. to be discovering
ex.t: 旅游团每天下午1点整从水坝广场出发，每小时一班。

ex.s: to be discoveredD. to have discovered
ex.t: 你可以在MacBike商店购票或在线预订。

ex.s: Although I have enjoyed breaking my decades-long taboo about working with oil paints, I have discovered I now prefer chalks and ink.
ex.t: 虽然我很享受打破几十年来不用油画创作的禁忌，但我发现自己现在更喜欢粉笔和墨水。

ex.s: During my third year, I discovered that after treating thousands of seeds, I obtained just one plant I could use for experiments.
ex.t: 在我第三年里，我发现，经过对数千种种子的治疗，我只得到了一种植物，我可以用来做实验。

ex.s: It is encouraging to discover that by readily accepting our errors and wisely placing ourselves in the way of being wrong, we can in fact overcome weaknesses and rise stronger.
ex.t: 令人鼓舞的是，我们发现，通过欣然接受错误、明智地让自己处于可能犯错的位置，我们事实上能克服弱点、变得更强。

ex.s: The city discovered its harbor.
ex.t: 这座城市发现了它的港口。

ex.s: Some scientists insist that once we discover the truth about the world, we are done.
ex.t: 一些科学家坚持认为，一旦我们发现了世界的真相，就大功告成了。

ex.s: The history of science offers many examples of matters that scientists thought they had resolved, only to discover that these matters needed to be reconsidered.
ex.t: 科学史提供了许多这样的例子：科学家们以为已经解决了的问题，后来却发现需要重新考虑。

ex.s: Even though he often felt he would be discovered to be a no-talent, he moved forward, gaining a scholarship to the Neighborhood Playhouse and making his first television appearance a few years later in 1948.
ex.t: 尽管他常常觉得自己会被发现毫无才华，他仍继续前行，获得了邻里剧院的奖学金，并在几年后的1948年首次登上电视。

ex.s: A study conducted in Youngstown，Ohio，for example, discovered that greener areas of the city experienced less crime.
ex.t: 例如，在俄亥俄州扬斯敦进行的一项研究发现，城市里绿化更好的区域犯罪更少。

ex.s: One day they’ll   47   and discover that everything they’ve always known about windows is a   48  .I wonder if   49   should always tell the truth no matter the   50  .
ex.t: 有一天他们会___47___，发现他们一直以来对窗户的认知是个___48___。我想知道，不管___50___如何，我们是否都应该说真话。

ex.s: Discover the China of“past ages，its walled cities，temples and mountain scenery with Prof  Robert Thorp.
ex.t: 与Robert Thorp教授一起发现"过去时代"的中国，它的城墙环绕的城市、寺庙和山地风光。

ex.s: There are no more continents and no more moons to search for, little left to discover.
ex.t: 已经没有更多的大洲和卫星可以寻找了，几乎没有什么留待发现的了。

ex.s: This new start gave me an opportunity to redefine myself and discover an entirely new version of "cool".
ex.t: 这个新的开始让我有机会重新定义自己，并发现一个全新的“酷”的版本。

ex.s: But recently it has discovered that data can be turned into new services: translation and visual recognition, to be sold to other companies.
ex.t: 但最近它发现数据可以被转化为新服务：翻译和视觉识别，然后出售给其他公司。

ex.s: The team discovered that some synapses seem to be protected and stayed the same size.
ex.t: 研究团队发现，某些突触似乎受到保护，保持了相同的尺寸。

ex.s: People are also discovering the fun of interacting with the celebrations, rather than simply watching as part of an audience.
ex.t: 她接受了，但表示她必须坐经济舱。

ex.s: Researchers from Brigham Young University discovered that fathers are in a unique position to help their adolescent children learn persistence.
ex.t: 来自Brigham Young大学的研究人员发现，父亲们在帮助青少年子女学习持久性方面处于独特的地位。

ex.s: Or maybe you end up switching your attention away from novels, and discover the history of romantic poets in England.
ex.t: 或者你可能最终把注意力从小说上转移开，发现了英国浪漫派诗人的历史。

ex.s: Discover, explore and enjoy award-winning Tullie House, where historic collections, contemporary art and family fun are brought together in one impressive museum and art gallery.
ex.t: 探索、欣赏Tullie House这个获奖场所，这里将历史收藏、当代艺术和家庭乐趣汇集在一个令人印象深刻的博物馆和美术馆中。

defs.def: to find sb/sth that was hidden or that you did not expect to find （出乎意料地）发现，找到，发觉

ex.s: But gold was discovered there in 1897, and two years later, it was one of the largest cities in the West, with a population of 30,000.
ex.t: 但1897年在那里发现了黄金，两年后，它成为西部最大的城市之一，人口达30000人。

ex.s: At best, you may just find that you have discovered something completely new and unexpected, through a flash of inspiration that you would have missed with perfectionism.
ex.t: 往好了说，你或许会发现，通过一瞬灵感，你发现了某种全新而意外的事物——而若追求完美，你会与之失之交臂。

ex.s: And it was in Chile she discovered she could get last-minute cheap deals on ships going to Antarctica from the islands off Tierra del Fuego, the southernmost tip of the South American mainland.
ex.t: 正是在智利，她发现可以从南美洲大陆最南端的火地岛群岛获得前往南极洲的廉价船票。

ex.s: Then you discover the pressure of having to keep up.
ex.t: 然后你会发现必须跟上步伐的压力。

ex.s: Some of your interests may not appear to be connected but, once you explore their depths, you discover that they are.
ex.t: 你的一些兴趣可能看起来互不相干，但一旦你探究它们的深度，就会发现它们是相关的。

ex.s: We are repeatedly willing to imagine we have found most of what is left to discover.
ex.t: 我们总是一厢情愿地以为，所剩待发现的东西大都已经被我们找到。

ex.s: Moreover, how would you feel if you discovered that the people closest to you had been hiding the truth from you?
ex.t: 此外，如果你发现最亲近的人一直在向你隐瞒真相，你会作何感受？

ex.s: Little did I know that I would discover my  45    for ASL.
ex.t: 我万万没想到，我会发现自己对ASL（美国手语）的____45____（天赋/热爱）。

defs.def: to find out about sth; to find some information about sth 了解到；认识到；查明

ex.s: To discover their attitudes towards art.
ex.t: 为了了解他们对艺术的态度。

ex.s: Discover why artists and photographers continue to be drawn to this special place.
ex.t: 探索为什么艺术家和摄影师一直被这个特别的地方所吸引。

ex.s: Discover how architects, product designers and scientists use similar skills in their work.
ex.t: 了解建筑师、产品设计师和科学家如何在工作中运用相似的技能……

ex.s: Discover and enjoy 4 centuries of history, 5 acres of celebrated and award-winning gardens with parkland walk.
ex.t: 探索并享受四个世纪的历史、5英亩屡获殊荣的花园和公园步道。

ex.s: Discover William Wordsworth’s inspirational home.
ex.t: 探访William Wordsworth充满灵感的故居。

ex.s: The Intelligent Transport team at Newcastle University have turned an electric car into a mobile laboratory named “Drive LAB” in order to understand the challenges faced by older drivers and to discover where the key stress points are.
ex.t: 纽卡斯尔大学的智能交通团队把一辆电动汽车改造成了一个名为“Drive LAB”的移动实验室，以了解老年驾驶者面临的挑战，并找出关键的压力点在哪里。

defs.def: to be the first person to realize that sb is very good at singing, acting, etc. and help them to become successful and famous 发现，发掘（人才）

ex.s: At that time I discovered blogging and found that I took pretty good pictures.
ex.t: 那时我发现了写博客，并且发现自己拍的照片相当不错。

ex.s: It can even help solve present-day problems: In 2015, scientists discovered that a 10th-century English medicine for eve problems could kill a drug-resistant virus.
ex.t: 它甚至能帮助解决当下的问题：2015年，科学家发现一种10世纪治疗眼睛问题的英国药方能杀死耐药病毒。

ex.s: （1）What have scientists discovered with the help of mathematical models of food webs？
ex.t: （1）借助食物网的数学模型，科学家发现了什么？
